evidence.quote: stubborn housing inflation and high inflation in certain goods and services categories may stall progress in reaching our target.
If any risks arise that stall progress or reaccelerate inflation, it would be appropriate to pause our policy rate cuts.
But if the labor market slows down suddenly, it would be appropriate to continue to gradually reduce the policy rate.
we need to continue paying attention to both sides of our mandate.
